title: Sương núi
about: Round x8, in directions of my own choosing, as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm nhiều bài nữa, hướng bạn tự đề xuất"): eastern dark: mist on the mountains at night; the plucked string breaking the chords slowly, a far choir and the pad, a bowl now and then. E minor pentatonic colours at 50 bpm. An original piece.
